message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 8‑10 servings) |
|----------|------------|------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | • Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | • Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | • Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | • Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | • Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | • Dried oregano, basil, salt, pepper | to taste |
| | • Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (White Sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan (top layer) | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Sautéed spinach or kale | 2 cups |
| | Sliced mushrooms | 1 cup |
| | Roasted red peppers | ½ cup |
| | Fresh basil leaves (for garnish) | as desired |

### Quick Prep Tips
1. **Cook the noodles** according to package instructions (or use no‑boil sheets to skip this step). Drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil until translucent, add ground meat, cook until browned, then stir in tomatoes, paste, wine, and herbs. Simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mix**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Whisk the bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour until smooth, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
5. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of meat sauce, then noodles, ricotta mixture, bechamel, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
6. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 min, or until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10 min before serving.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
